outline:
本課程將以團隊合作模式進行三項活動競賽(寰騰動、寰騰撼、寰騰賽)。課程設計為兩天的內容:包括1.隊呼競賽2.闖關活動3.哈佛個案競賽以呼應EMBA應具備的四到(學到、交到、玩到、做到)。
This course is to develop the ability to lead business transformation and team building in the dynamic economic environment. There are three parts in this course: 1. Cheerleading contest 2. Team building activities 3. Harvard Business School case contest. The goals of this course are four must does in EMBA( to Learn, Make friends, practice, and achieve).
